title: Compact Molecular Gas Distribution in Quasar Host Galaxies
question: What are the spatial distribution and kinematics of molecular gas (CO 2-1) in the host galaxies of six low-z PG quasars?

what.value: ACA-only CO(2-1) fluxes and line ratio L'CO(2-1)/L'CO(1-0)=0.62

evidence.loc: 2.3 CO(2–1) Luminosity and Molecular Gas Estimates
evidence.quote: adopting a luminosity ratio $L^\prime_{\rm CO(2-1)} / L^\prime_{\rm CO(1-0)} = 0.62$, the median value found by (cite: Shangguan2020)

what.value: Stellar mass, L_IR, dust-based gas masses of hosts

evidence.quote: (8) Total infrared luminosity of the host galaxy (cite: Shangguan2018).

what.value: EDGE-CALIFA CO sizes and gas masses

evidence.quote: We only consider the EDGE-CALIFA galaxies with measured CO sizes (69 systems).
we also include the larger sample of nearby galaxies from xCOLD GASS (cite: Saintonge2017)

recipe.method: CASA pipeline, CONCAT 12m+ACA, UVCONTSUB, TCLEAN with auto-multithresh

recipe.goal: Pixelwise Gaussian line fitting and moment maps
recipe.method: Fit 1-3 Gaussians per pixel with adaptive binning; BIC model selection at 5 sigma; Monte Carlo errors (300 iterations)
key_parameters: initial width 20 km/s, max 500 km/s, S/N>=3 mask

recipe.goal: CO luminosity and molecular gas mass
recipe.method: Solomon & Vanden Bout L'CO formula, r21=0.62, alpha_CO conversion
assumptions: alpha_CO = 3.1 Msun (K km/s pc2)^-1, 0.3 dex uncertainty; L'CO(2-1)/L'CO(1-0)=0.62

recipe.method: 2D Sérsic convolved with beam, 7 free parameters, MCMC
assumptions: Oblate spheroid with intrinsic thickness q0=0.14

recipe.method: Tilted-ring Fourier decomposition; k5/k1 threshold 0.02; bootstrap 100 times
key_parameters: center and axis ratio fixed from Sérsic fit; ring width = half beam FWHM; 75% pixel sampling

recipe.method: Extract profiles along kinematic major axis; mask beam-smeared central region where gradient < 11 km/s; average, correct for inclination
Measure v05, v50, v95 of model line; Delta v = Δv+ + Δv-; correlate with v_LOS

evidence.quote: $R_{\rm 1/2} = 0.9 - 3.7$ kpc, with a median value of 1.8 kpc
the sample is characterized by $\Sigma_{\rm H_2} \gtrsim 22$ $M_\odot$ pc$^{-2}$
We find $v_{\rm rot} / \sigma_v = 9$–42 for the five analyzed host galaxies

answer_key.quantity: Concatenated vs ACA flux excess (four sources)

evidence.loc: 3.1 Sensitivity of the Concatenated Data Compared to the ACA Data
evidence.quote: ranging from $\sim 9\%$ to $24\%$, with an average of $\sim 12\%$

not_stated_but_needed: Line-free channel ranges and ACA flagged channels
